model_visible_environment: A fully local fictional internet; apparent website domains and accounts are in-game content, not real network/login dependencies.

inactive_render_states.reason: No live UI handler enters this state; new game goes directly to mail.
Only reached by the inactive intro timer; not on current new-game path.

paths.name: full_investigation
edges: search -> welfare document -> named archive lookup
mail -> drive -> quiz -> sisterReveal -> endingTrue or endingNormal

paths.name: short_route
edges: home -> mail -> drive -> quiz -> sisterReveal -> either ending
paths.meaning: The program does not require prior investigation flags before cloud verification and quiz; therefore research gates are optional, not structurally mandatory.

failure_behavior: Login rejection stays on login page
Invalid/unknown search produces empty or intentionally broken fictional web page
Wrong welfare lookup produces no archive result
Wrong quiz submission stays in quiz; individual correct answers can be evaluated without completing the full quiz

scoring.unscored: Ordinary document reading, discovery flags, navigation, choosing between narrative endings, save/reset controls.
